note: Harness and stored values and expectations only; no acceptance rule (control-expert judges). Harness seed L1|s0 = error-free sensors, the Chrono runs have ideal leg sensors and IMU grade ideal (A3: grade ideal, seed 12345), so L1|s0 is the row to compare; L2 seeds show the sensor spread a single Chrono run cannot sample.
units: stroke mm, force kN (true cylinder force minimum after the crawler lift-off), time s after the run start, b_RL = applied LOC anchor bias of RL

E1.definition: edge roll 2.2 pitch 1.6 deg, RL g_start 230 mm, top, C4G2 on, K1 off, L1-R plant F_s 0 (A3 conditions)
E1.F_s_mismatch: Harness values are F_s 4 kN, this row is F_s 0. No harness C4G2 row at F_s 0 is stored. Stored harness F_s 0 is the older AG2c5 row (rev70/r71_p28acc_harness_Fs0.json): clearance 92.3 mm, RL min 30.37 kN.
E1.expected: A hold event at the TOUCH end; s_motor bit-equal to A3 before it if the thread setting does not matter; RL minimum above the 43.06 kN of A3 (harness direction, F_s differs); FR not near 682.8 mm (harness 644.3 at F_s 4).

R2.definition: rpB roll 2.7355 pitch 1.7592 deg (rule value 1.17, outside the operating start rule), RL g_start 230 mm, top, C4G2 off, L2b F_s 4 kN, flow limit off
R2.expected: READY about 66 s without stop; FR on one of two branches about 657 or 682 mm (b_RL about -86 or -61 mm, the t_P sample jump noted in decision_log); RL minimum about 35 kN.

R3.definition: as R2, C4G2 on, K1 off
R3.expected: READY about 66 s or the known safe stop (`WARN_LIFT_STROKE_LIMITED:FR` then FAULT, 5 of 25 harness seeds, 0 of 25 off). FR about 681 to 684 mm: the row is within about 2 mm of the guard, so a Chrono offset of a few mm decides READY or stop by itself. RL minimum about 53 kN.

R2L1.definition: as R2 on L1-R, plant F_s 0, flow limit off, C4G2 off
R2L1.harness_Fs0_note: No harness row of rpB RL g230 at F_s 0 is stored (search of 06_analysis/02_control for slope|rpB|top|0.0|RL|raised|230: 0 matches). The F_s 4 row below is a reference only, it is not this condition.
R2L1.expected: No numeric expectation at F_s 0. Same compliant crawler type as the harness (h within 0.4 mm), READY or stop not predicted.

R3L1.definition: as R3 on L1-R, plant F_s 0, flow limit off, C4G2 on, K1 off
R3L1.harness_Fs0_note: As R2L1: no stored harness row at F_s 0.
R3L1.expected: A hold event at the TOUCH end. No numeric expectation at F_s 0; the difference R3L1 minus R2L1 is the same-engine reading, subject to the b_RL branch rule.

reading_rules.branch: R2 and R3 differ by the b_RL branch as well as by the hold. The harness off row has both branches; a large FR difference between R2 and R3 is not by itself a C4G2 effect, read b_RL first.
reading_rules.engines: E1, R2L1, R3L1 are L1-R F_s 0; R2, R3 are L2b F_s 4. The pairs R2-R2L1 and R3-R3L1 change the engine, F_s and the crawler model together, so their difference is not an F_s effect alone. Do not compare E1 with R2 or R3.
reading_rules.patch: The L2b raised floor is new in this batch (unscheduled event patch); the block geometry check runs at the start of each L2b row. No stored L2b G8 run exists to compare with.
reading_rules.seeds: The table holds 23 plain L2 seeds per arm (s0 and s3 only under candidate tags), with 5 stops in the C4G2 arm; decision_log counts 25 seeds, 5 stops.

start_geometry.reading: The harness crawler is compliant (body 0.24 deg more nose down than the floor); the L2b crawler is rigid and sits on the floor plane. Same g_start, so h differs by 7.9 mm and the corner clearance at t_P differs. The harness values are not a bit reference for R2, R3: an offset of several mm is expected and its size is not known before the run.
